name: agent-nelly
description: A general-purpose, project-aware memory orchestration plugin for Claude Code — goal-aware briefs, cross-project promotion, staleness detection, and consolidation, independent of any other plugin.

shared_memory_root.title: Shared memory root
shared_memory_root.description: Optional. A directory shared by every machine and plugin install you use (a git repo is recommended; iCloud/Dropbox also work). When set, agent-nelly keeps its memory under <dir>/agent-nelly-memory/ instead of the per-install, per-machine plugin data dir. Use the same value for agent-nelly and agent-isdd. Leave empty to keep memory local.
